beats.text: Necochea, Argentina. A mother, cut at the throat. Her two children, dead beside her.
She blamed a neighbor. The police believed her — for one day.
Then someone noticed the bloody thumbprint on the bedroom door — it didn't belong to the neighbor at all.
It matched the file Inspector Alvarez had just built.
A system no one had ever used to solve a murder before.
Confronted with her own thumb, Francisca Rojas confessed.
